leads.posting: YC job posting: Taipei Software Engineer (Taipei; experience: Any (new grads ok); US citizenship/visa not required). Team size: 9. Apartment rental marketplace RentHop (www.renthop.com) helps renters find great apartments. We use sophisticated data analysis to rank apartment listings based on their "freshness"​, their accuracy and completeness and the responsiveness of the manager who listed the apartment on our site. As a renter, you can use list-based or map-based search tools to browse listings and comprehensive search filters to narrow our 100,000+ listings to just the ones you want. It’s easy and fast to reach out to brokers and property managers to schedule viewings and to manage responses. You can also use our innovative "Appointments on Demand"​ feature, a map showing the real-time locations of brokers and property managers available to show apartments, to reach out and schedule viewings on the fly! For brokers and property managers, RentHop provides a cost-effective, easy-to-use tool to promote your listings, get qualified leads and schedule viewings. You can also post and repost listings on the go using RentHop Manager, our mobile app for brokers and property managers, currently available in the iOS App Store. (You can download the mobile app at https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/renthop-manager/id695651355.) Your commitment to give good service will make you stand out on RentHop - our algorithm will credit you for your responsiveness and help give your listings the boost they need to get seen - and rented - by qualified renters. Look for our mobile app for consumers, due out soon! And please let us know any questions, thoughts or comments you may have - we'll look forward to hearing from you! You can reach us at feedback@renthop.com. You can also find us on Facebook, Twitter (@RentHop), Google+ and Pinterest. Marketplace, Real Estate, Real Estate and Construction, Housing and Real Estate, United States of America, America / Canada

It can sign in through your browser, work inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets, and keep going when a task takes minutes or hours. leads.title: Junior FDE (AI & Backend)
leads.posting: Junior FDE (AI & Backend): 1-3 Years of Experience Context We are building AI-native products on the Anthropic API and MCP, backed by a Django/DRF + PostgreSQL platform and a React/Next.js frontend, deployed on Azure. The team works in an AI-assisted workflow (agentic AI coding tools are a daily tool), so the Junior FDE must be able to review, understand and own every line that ships. This is a build-and-learn role: you work from tickets a senior has scoped, with code review on every change, and grow into owning full features. What the role owns Own scoped tickets end-to-end: build DRF endpoints and models, implement individual LLM workflows (prompts, tool calls, MCP tools), fix bugs from logs and traces, and test what you ship — then take feedback from review and cut repeat mistakes. The actual workload (by share of time); Backend features & APIs (~35%) DRF models, serializers, viewsets, migrations on PostgreSQL • e.g. "Add a filter + pagination to the cases list API" • e.g. "New field with migration and serializer" LLM workflows, skills & MCP connectors (~25%) Prompts, tool use, agent skills, custom MCP tools/connectors • e.g. "Add an MCP tool that fetches a matter's documents" • e.g. "Write a skill for the intake checklist" • e.g. "Tighten the extraction prompt" Async jobs & integrations (~15%) Celery/Redis tasks, third-party APIs, auth (JWT/OAuth2) • e.g. "Move document summarisation to a Celery task with retry" Bugs & debugging (~15%) • e.g. "Task stuck in pending — find why" • e.g. "500 on empty payload" Tests, review & light frontend (~10%) pytest, PR cycles, small React/Next.js fixes • e.g. "Add tests for the new endpoint" • e.g. "Wire the new API into the Next.js list page" Priority reality: tickets arrive with mixed urgency. A Junior FDE flags blockers early, asks before guessing, and escalates anything touching auth, data or production to a senior rather than fixing it alone. Tech stack AI/LLM engineering: Anthropic API, MCP (Model Context Protocol), agen
